title: quality-debt: Dockerfile — PR #1 review feedback (medium)
body:
## Unactioned Review Feedback

<!-- provenance:start — workers: skip to implementation below -->
**Source PR**: #1
**File**: `Dockerfile`
**Reviewers**: human
**Findings**: 3
**Max severity**: medium
<!-- provenance:end -->

---

### MEDIUM: human (Copilot)
**File**: `Dockerfile:6`
**Verification**: kept as unverifiable (no stable snippet extracted)
The `RUN type -p curl >/dev/null || apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl` uses `||`/`&&` without grouping; in POSIX shells this is evaluated left-to-right as `(type -p curl || apt-get update) && apt-get install ...`, so `apt-get install` runs even when curl exists, and may run without an `apt-get update`, which can make the build fail due to missing/stale package lists. Restructure this to either always do `apt-get update` before any `apt-get install`, or wrap the conditional in an explicit `if`/parentheses so `apt-get update` and `apt-get install` are both skipped when curl is already present.


<!-- provenance:start -->
[View comment](https://github.com/Majowka/arc-runner/pull/1#discussion_r3240469516)
<!-- provenance:end -->
---

### MEDIUM: human (Copilot)
**File**: `Dockerfile:5`
**Verification**: kept as unverifiable (no stable snippet extracted)
The comment says this block installs `gh CLI + jq`, but the command also installs `python3`. Update the comment so it accurately reflects what’s being installed (or split installs if the intent is different).


<!-- provenance:start -->
[View comment](https://github.com/Majowka/arc-runner/pull/1#discussion_r3240469564)
<!-- provenance:end -->
---

### MEDIUM: human (Copilot)
**File**: `Dockerfile:9`
**Verification**: kept as unverifiable (no stable snippet extracted)
The `curl ... | dd of=...` pipeline can mask download failures because `/bin/sh` doesn’t enable `pipefail`, so the RUN step will only see `dd`’s exit code. Consider avoiding the pipe (e.g., download directly to the destination path) or switching the Dockerfile shell to one that supports `pipefail` so a failed `curl` reliably fails the build.


<!-- provenance:start -->
[View comment](https://github.com/Majowka/arc-runner/pull/1#discussion_r3240505391)

title: Supervisor health dashboard stale: 7d6h (#12)
body:
## Premise

The dashboard at #12 last refreshed `2026-08-09T18:11:25Z` — **7d6h ago** (threshold: 2d0h). The `stats-wrapper.sh` scheduler is likely failing silently.

## Why this matters

The supervisor health dashboard is the framework's primary single-glance health surface. When it stops refreshing, operators keep trusting green numbers that no longer reflect reality — every decision derived from "dashboard says green" becomes invalid.

## Triage

1. Inspect the stats scheduler status.

   macOS / launchd:

   ```bash
   launchctl list | grep -i aidevops-stats-wrapper
   tail -40 ~/.aidevops/logs/stats.log
   ls -la ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist
   ```

   Linux / systemd user timers:

   ```bash
   systemctl --user status aidevops-stats-wrapper.timer --no-pager
   systemctl --user status aidevops-stats-wrapper.service --no-pager
   systemctl --user list-timers --all --no-pager 'aidevops*'
   tail -40 ~/.aidevops/logs/stats.log
   ls -la ~/.config/systemd/user/aidevops-stats-wrapper.*
   ```

2. Run the refresh manually and capture the error:

   ```bash
   bash ~/.aidevops/agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh 2>&1 | tail -40
   ```

3. Check the dashboard issue directly:

   ```bash
   gh api repos/Majowka/arc-runner/issues/12 --jq '{updated_at, body_length: (.body|length)}'
   ```

## Remediation

- **macOS missing plist:** re-run `setup.sh --non-interactive` (or `aidevops update`) with PULSE_ENABLED=true so `setup_stats_wrapper` reinstalls `com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist`.
- **Linux missing or inactive systemd timer:** re-run `setup.sh --non-interactive` (or `aidevops update`) with PULSE_ENABLED=true so the Linux scheduler setup reinstalls and enables `aidevops-stats-wrapper.timer` and `aidevops-stats-wrapper.service` under `~/.config/systemd/user`.
- **`set -euo pipefail` fail:** the post-t2418 wrapper emits `HEALTH-DASHBOARD-FAIL exit=<N>` on error. Grep `stats.log` on that prefix.
- **Body size / API error:** inspect `stats.log` — look at `gh` HTTP errors and `_update_health_issue_for_repo` failures.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Root cause identified and documented on this issue.
- [ ] `gh issue view 12 --repo Majowka/arc-runner` shows an update within 24h of closing this alert.
- [ ] `last_refresh:` marker is present in the dashboard body.
